TECHNICAL FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

DSPOWER PREMIUM CEMENT (Dhalai Power) and ULTRIX CEMENT are specifically engineered for RCC slab casting. Their 30% fly ash pozzolanic matrix reduces the heat of hydration, virtually eliminating thermal shrinkage cracks, while pore refinement prevents water percolation and steel rebar corrosion.
PPC stands for Portland Pozzolana Cement (governed by IS:1489 Part-1 in India). It is manufactured by inter-grinding high-grade clinker, gypsum, and carefully selected pozzolanic materials (fly ash). It delivers superior long-term strength, lower hydration heat, enhanced workability, and high resistance against environmental dampness compared to ordinary OPC.
Yes. K S Enterprise provides direct site truckload delivery throughout Guwahati (including Beltola, Jalukbari, Dispur, Six Mile, Khanapara, Lokhra, Garchuk, Panbazar) and surrounding districts within 24 hours of order confirmation.
All DSPOWER and ULTRIX cement bags are supplied in standard factory-sealed 50 kg (net weight) moisture-proof laminated bags.
Store bags inside a dry, leak-proof shed on raised wooden pallets positioned at least 15 to 20 cm (6-8 inches) off the ground and 30 cm away from exterior walls. Cover the stacks completely with heavy-duty waterproof tarpaulins and follow first-in, first-out (FIFO) rotation.
K S Enterprise provides official NABL-accredited batch test certificates, IS:1489 Part-1 factory compliance reports, and physical manufacturer product brochures before dispatch.
